title: Steelers' Yahya Black says he weighs 370 in mic'd up talk with 340-pound Tristan Wirfs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers' Yahya Black says he weighs 370 in mic'd up talk with 340-pound Tristan Wirfs
sources.description: Buccaneers offensive tackle Tristan Wirfs doesn't often come across people bigger than him, but he did on Sunday, when he played against Steelers defensive tackle Yahya Black.
